operations.name: result_read
operations.reply: raw byte range; requested count must fit the supplied reply capacity

field_policy: all defined request/reply fields use must-understand bit; unknown optional fields skip; unknown must-understand fields reject
sequence_policy: all requests use nonzero increasing sequence; identical live retries return recorded outcome; differing bytes reject; acknowledge through completed previously admitted sequence, close unused lower gaps; retired IDs expire
result_policy: result handles survive originating outcome acknowledgement until explicit release; replay referring to a released result expires; results not exposed through RESULT_AVAILABLE retire with their originating outcome; result-read replay requires its original requested count to fit
